label: s32_st_rain_after_school
title: Rain, After School
summary: The quiet one. Iris admits to the private index. Exercises: weather gate, relationship threshold, knowledge on both sides, and delayed branching — trust 7 needs the warm answer at the first shift, hours earlier, for a reason the player had no way to see coming. The threshold was 12 and then 10; both required the best branch of TWO separate scenes, which put it at 1/9 of runs before the weather and the time of day were even considered. Milestone 1 then added evening content at four other locations, the wander diluted, and 2000 runs reached it zero times. Gating on a near-maximum is fragile: one new scene can strand it.
